काव्य a. [कवि-यण्]
1 Possessed
of the qualities of a sage or a poet.
--2 Praiseworthy, fit to be described.
--3 Prophetic, inspired, poetical.

Asuras.
--व्या
1 Intelligence.
--2 A
female fiend.

1 A poem;
महाकाव्यं; मेघदूतं नाम काव्यं &c.
--2 Poetics,
poetry, poetical composition. (काव्य
